tests.name: Long Context: Tallies Across a 12k-Token Log
tests.description: Six questions that each need every line of a 12k-token gateway log: two counts, a total, the slowest request, the worst health check, and one question the log cannot answer.
tests.goal: At least five of six right: 8 requests returned 502; the 499s add up to 9,827 input tokens; 3 notebook-lab-3 requests used nomic-embed-text; the slowest request is r-693757; the worst p95 is 2,200 ms; and no client was rate-limited (null). Sized so a model with a 32k context window keeps about 20k tokens to work through the log.

accuracy.expect: Adds up the in= values of the six 499 requests: 9,827
Counts the 3 notebook-lab-3 requests that used nomic-embed-text
Names r-693757 (9,248 ms) as the slowest request, not the runner-up at 9,208 ms
Finds the highest health-check p95: 2,200 ms
Answers null for the rate-limited client: the log has no 429

quality.expect: Replies with only the fenced JSON block
The object has exactly the six requested keys
Numbers are JSON integers, the req id is a string, and 'none' is a JSON null
